description:
Make everyday rotis & dosas high in protein!

Does your picky eater refuse dal, paneer, or milk but happily eats roti? 
Just add 1 scoop of Proteinmix to their roti dough — 
no taste change, so kids can’t even tell!

💪 12g Protein Per Scoop

2x the protein in regular roti to support growing kids.

🌱 100% Plant-Based Protein

No whey. Gentle on digestion and light on the stomach — ideal for kids and everyday family use.

🥣 Mix Into Everyday Meals

Add it to your daily atta or batter for:

- Chapati

- Paratha

- Dosa

- Cheela

- Baking recipes

No new recipes. No extra effort.

✨ Clean, Worry-Free Nutrition

- No sugar

- No gluten

- No preservatives

❤️ Approved by moms, loved by kids.

For kids under 4 years, consult your pediatrician before use.

Add, Mix, Cook!🥣

Add 1 scoop to atta or batter before cooking and proceed as usual.

How Much to Add?

🥙Roti: 1 scoop in 100g flour (3–4 chapatis)

🥞Pancake: 1 scoop in 150g batter

🫓Dosa/Cheela: 1 scoop in 250g batter

Same taste. Same smell. Zero difference.

Max 1 scoop daily (12g protein) for kids 4+ years.

reviews.author: Priya Sharma
reviews.title: Bilkul taste nahi badla!
reviews.body: Maine pehli baar try kiya aur sach mein bacche ko pata hi nahi laga. Roz roti mein dal deti hoon. Bahut acha product hai.

reviews.author: Rekha Verma
reviews.title: Doctor wali problem solve
reviews.body: Mera beta sirf roti khata hai. Dal, paneer, sabzi kuch nahi. Doctor ne bola protein ki kami hai. Yeh milaya toh ab tension nahi hai.

reviews.author: Ananya Nair
reviews.title: Works exactly as promised
reviews.body: Tested it myself first before giving to my kid. Absolutely no taste difference. Now I use it daily for my daughter's chapati. She has no idea and I feel so much better about her nutrition.

reviews.author: Sunita Agarwal
reviews.title: Highly recommend!
reviews.body: Very good product. No smell, no taste change. My daughter doesn't even know I'm giving her extra protein.

reviews.author: Vimla Rawat
reviews.title: Sach mein koi taste nahi
reviews.body: Mujhe vishwas nahi ho raha tha. Socha tha baccha pehchaan lega. Lekin sach mein bilkul nahi pata chala. Roti waisi hi lagi. Itni badi tension khatam ho gayi.
